mode.description: Instrument mode (required for spawn; optional when polling job_id)

prompt.description: Task text / research query / design or implement description

design_doc_path.description: Required for execute_plan; jailed path to design doc

effort.description: implement 1-5 (skill flag inside -p only; never CLI --effort)

async.description: Background job; default true when mode timeout > 15m; false for prompt

job_id.description: Poll/fetch prior async job (poll-only when set)

base_branch.description: execute_plan base branch preflight; default working

cwd.description: Git repo / working directory (path-jailed under allowed roots)

target.description: review: local | branch name | PR number/URL
